haiku.problem: "What picture did he use for it?" has no clear referent. "It" points to "everything people do under the sun," but the picture is for futility. The question should name the thing the picture describes.
"The Teacher" is never identified in this question. Questions 2 and 3 say he was a king in Jerusalem, but this one does not, so a baker asked at random would not know who is meant.
